body.x: ARMediaWorks (CEO Son Jeong-bong) will be exhibiting at CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition held in Las Vegas from January 5 to 8, (PIOS) platform, which will be exhibited at the same time.

ARMediaWorks has developed a PIAS service platform that enables more efficient picking operations that take up the largest portion of the logistics system, utilizing smart glass (EYEWEAR) and Augmented Reality (AR) technologies.

PIOS utilizes Augmented Reality technology to use Vision Picking, which displays information such as product area, location, order quantity, etc. in the logistics warehouse displayed on EYEWEAR as if floating in the air. This allows the two hands to be free and easy to find in the warehouse.

In addition, the scientific puzzle system to be presented by ARMedia Works is a “digilogue” puzzle system based on mobile augmented reality. It is combined with the concept of analog play to help the development of sociality, creativity, inquiry and concentration of children aged 5 to 7 years.

It is also a science teaching tool that allows you to combine module puzzles using both hands and to discover and study your own combination of mechanisms by checking 3D images in real time with Smart Glass (EYEWEAR).

On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Business School and Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened the CES Daegu Joint Pavilion and support the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an annual showcase of the global consumer electronics industry, held every January by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA).
